notablePrerequisites:
Myrel does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
You control at least five Soldiers.
description:
Declare Myrel as an attacker.
Myrel triggers, creating at least five 1/1 Soldier artifact creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five Soldier tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
